items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 17 at 11:00AM AKDT until August 17 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult by air, land, and sea.
Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued August 16 at 10:53PM AKDT until August 18 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK

items.headline: Flood Watch issued August 16 at 12:33PM AKDT until August 19 at 6:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Including the following areas, Central Susitna Valley,
Southern Susitna Valley and Western Susitna Valley. This includes
the cities of Skwentna, Willow, Talkeetna, Trapper Creek, And
Petersville.

* WHEN...From 7 PM AKDT this evening through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Significant
items.areas: Western Susitna Valley; Southern Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.
